caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a case made of reddish-brown wood and accented with gold trim. The clock is rectangular in shape with a wide base featuring a circular inlay design outlined in gold. The central section of the body has a long, vertical door that contains an elongated oval inlay in a slightly different shade of brown with a gold border, and additional gold accent lines run vertically along the sides. The top section of the clock houses the clock face, which is round and has black Roman numerals and two black hands. The clock face is set in a square with gold borders and contains some decorative elements, including a floral motif above the clock face framed by an arch. The top of the clock case features an ornate, openwork pediment with three gold finials—one at each side and one at the top center. The wood of the clock appears polished, and the background of the image is a plain, slightly textured light tan color.
title: Tall Clock
